component.name: Yoink
component.summary: Download high-fidelity video and audio, locally

description.p: Yoink is a local desktop app for downloading high-fidelity video and audio from many sites. It is powered by yt-dlp and bundles ffmpeg, so nothing extra needs to be installed.

ul.li: Pick format and quality, extract audio, and choose the audio bitrate.
Import tracks from music services and tag them from the exact source metadata.
Playlists, embedded subtitles and chapters, and a persistent download queue.
